description: This PHP abstract class 'GeneratorAbstract' in the Zend Framework's XmlRpc Generator package provides a base for XML generator adapters. It includes methods for constructing XML by opening and closing elements, writing text data, and managing XML strings and encoding.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_GeneratorAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing core XML generation methods for Zend Framework's XmlRpc generator adapters, including element handling and output management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a specified XML encoding.

methods.name: openElement
methods.description: Starts a new XML element with an optional value.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Abstract method to return the XML as a string.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Returns the current XML encoding setting.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Returns the current XML and resets internal state.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML string without the declaration.

methods.name: stripDeclaration
methods.description: Removes XML declaration from a string.

methods.name: _openElement
methods.description: Abstract method to start an XML element.

methods.name: _writeTextData
methods.description: Abstract method to write text data into the current element.

methods.name: _closeElement
methods.description: Abstract method to close an XML element.
